name: hcportal_getEventMessages
description: Returns one run's chat for the portal: every live message (Removed = 0) by a hasher who is not removed and whom the caller has not blocked (HC.HasherFriendMap.Ignore = 1, E9.F1.S16), newest first, with author JSON, kind, reply quote, reactions and a per-row canDelete; then the ids of removed messages; then reaction changes since @reactionsSince and the server time to pass back. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicEventId as the context identifier; any authenticated portal user may read any event's chat (no kennel permission gate). canDelete = author or HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat. Delta: @sinceSequenceCount limits rowset 0 to newer messages; @reactionsSince drives rowset 2.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token, validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicEventId as the context identifier.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: Required: public event ID. Validated for NULL after auth. Used to resolve Event.id for message retrieval. Returns 'Event not found' if no matching event exists.

parameters.name: sinceSequenceCount
parameters.description: Delta fetch: only messages with a higher MessageSequenceCount; NULL = full fetch

parameters.name: reactionsSince
parameters.description: The last reactionsAsOf this client saw (E9.F1.S22). With it, the reader returns reactions changed since then on messages at or below sinceSequenceCount.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned alone on auth failure ('ValidatePortalAuth' message), 'publicEventId is required' or 'Event not found'. The CATCH returns the same shape (ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE()) AFTER logging to HC.ErrorLog, possibly following rowsets already sent.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Auth error (NVARCHAR(255)), validation literal, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH

rowsets.name: EventMessages
rowsets.description: On success. Live messages (msg.Removed = 0, author not removed, author not blocked by the caller), newer than @sinceSequenceCount when given, ORDER BY createdAt DESC.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Always the literal 'text' (kept for the chat widget; use messageKind for the real kind)

columns.name: text
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent (widened from 500 to 4000 by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-23_event_message_4000.sql; the table file still says 500)

columns.name: roomId
columns.description: The @publicEventId parameter, same on every row

columns.name: sequenceCount
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageSequenceCount; the client passes the highest back as @sinceSequenceCount

columns.name: canDelete
columns.description: 1 when the caller wrote the message or HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat allows them to moderate this run's chat

columns.name: replyToText
columns.description: First 200 characters of the quoted message; NULL when there is no quote or the quoted message was removed

columns.name: replyToAuthor
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName of the quoted message's author

columns.name: replyToRemoved
columns.description: 1 when the quoted message exists and has been removed

columns.name: author
columns.description: JSON object { id: Hasher.PublicHasherId, firstName: Hasher.DisplayName, imageUrl: Hasher.Photo } (JSON_QUERY ... FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER); the INNER JOIN means it is never NULL in practice

rowsets.name: RemovedMessageIds
rowsets.description: Every removed message in this run's chat (no delta filter), so an open chat drops any it already drew (E9.F1.S13/S14).

rowsets.name: ReactionUpdates
rowsets.description: Always present, empty when @reactionsSince is NULL: live messages at or below @sinceSequenceCount whose ReactionsUpdatedAt > @reactionsSince (E9.F1.S22). Find by column name.

rowsets.name: ReactionsAsOf
rowsets.description: One row: the server time to pass back as @reactionsSince.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH logs userId NULL and HcVersion '<portal>'
codeSmells.detail: Lines 153-155: @hasherId is known once auth has passed but the ErrorLog row is written with userId NULL, so a failure cannot be tied to the caller.

codeSmells.issue: Read SP returns an error envelope from CATCH instead of re-raising
codeSmells.detail: Lines 151-157: if the failure comes after rowset 0 has been sent, the client sees message rows followed by a {Success, ErrorMessage} rowset in the position it expects RemovedMessageIds. Logged, so diagnosable.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change the Unix epoch base date (1970-01-01) used for the createdAt millisecond conversion
Never change the message ordering (createdAt DESC) without frontend coordination
Never change the shape of the author JSON object — callers parse it by field name
